en: Clay waits at the bottom of the mine, past his workers. Water and Grass moves will wear his Ground types down!
Hey there, future champ! This Gym is a working mine. The lift takes you down, and the workers will dig in for a battle!
Here, have a drink before you go down!
Clay's Ground types don't care for Water or Grass moves. And Electric moves won't touch them at all!
You beat Clay! You dug deep, champ. Even the workers are cheering down there!
